definitions.gloss: 35th-day memorial service; fifth seven-day rite after death
definitions.explanation: In Japanese Buddhist funeral practice, a memorial rite held on the 35th day after a death, the fifth of the seven weekly services observed during the 49-day mourning period.

examples.japanese: {五七日|いつなのか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧によっては{五七日|いつなのか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{忌|い}み⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧とする。
examples.english: In some regions, the 35th-day service marks the end of mourning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{待|ま}てない→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{五七日|いつなのか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忌明|きあ}け→忌明け：29105_kiake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧とすることがある。
examples.english: When families cannot wait until the 49th day, the 35th-day service is sometimes treated as the mourning-ending rite instead.

notes:
{五七日|いつなのか} (literally "five sevens") is the fifth of the weekly Buddhist memorial services held after a death, falling on the 35th day.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{四七日|よなのか}→四七日：30933_yonanoka⟧: 28th-day service (fourth)
- ⟦{六七日|むなのか}→六七日：30935_munanoka⟧: 42nd-day service (sixth)
- ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧: 49th-day service (final)

In some regions and Buddhist sects, {五七日|いつなのか} rather than ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧ is treated as the formal end of mourning, especially when scheduling makes a 49th-day gathering difficult.
